ModuleName: Configuring AI Providers per Task and Using the Prompt Button

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: An ordered list of the topics and subtopics covered in this module, used by learners and instructors to preview the module's scope and navigate its sections.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to AI Tasks in PreseMaker
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory reading that defines what AI tasks are in PreseMaker, covers the platform's text-only generation scope, and lists the supported task types, giving learners the conceptual foundation needed before configuring AI settings.

Artifacts.Name: Assigning AI Providers to Task Types
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory reading that walks learners through how to access provider assignment in Settings, understand the available task types, and map specific AI providers to each task type to optimize for cost, speed, or quality.

Artifacts.Name: How PreseMaker Routes Tasks to Providers
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory reading that explains how PreseMaker's routing mechanism determines which AI provider handles each task, covering the role of the default provider and how per-task assignments override it, helping learners predict and control generation behavior.

Artifacts.Name: Using the Prompt Button
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory reading that describes the Prompt button in PreseMaker, explaining that it surfaces the exact text sent to an AI provider before or after generation, and showing learners how to use it to inspect, troubleshoot, and refine AI requests.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding and Responding to Generation Failures
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory reading that identifies the dependency chain involved in AI generation requests and explains how to diagnose and respond to generation failures, helping learners troubleshoot issues with credentials, network, or provider infrastructure.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding and Responding to Generation Failures
